label: ctrl-select-two
js: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('canvas.upper-canvas'); const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=layer-object-row][data-object-type=rect]')].map(e=>({x:Number(e.dataset.objectX),y:Number(e.dataset.objectY),w:Number(e.dataset.objectW),h:Number(e.dataset.objectH)})).sort((a,b)=>a.x-b.x); const z=Number(document.querySelector('[data-testid=zoom-level]')?.value||1), b=c?.getBoundingClientRect(); if(!c||rows.length<2)return false; const fire=(o,mod={})=>{const x=b.left+(o.x+o.w/2)*10*z,y=b.top+(o.y+o.h/2)*10*z,p={bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window,clientX:x,clientY:y,button:0,buttons:1,...mod}; c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',p)); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{...p,buttons:0}));}; fire(rows[0]); fire(rows[1],{ctrlKey:true}); return true; })()
